description: This file is a shell script for testing git checkout behavior with ambiguous references such as branches and tags. It sets up test repositories and checks that the system handles ambiguous and vague refs correctly, including warnings and correct branch switching messages.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified files for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file or output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets a prerequisite condition for subsequent tests.
